newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers steady, demand slightly up.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers steady, demand slightly up.

text.p: ARA bunkers were steady on Wednesday amid modest improvements in demand, with bunkers at most other ports steady to soft, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST remained at $119/$120 fob as fuel oil barges picked up from an early dip. Total enquiries in the Rotterdam area amounted to about 10,000 tonnes, but independent traders mostly lost out and majors completed a couple of larger deals.
"It's been an improvement, but certainly it's not great," one trader said.
Hamburg bunkers were also steady, at around $123 fob.
Mediterranean prices were largely unchanged and demand low.
The blockades by French lorry drivers continued to prevent truck shipments.
Fujairah fell further from its year high level set on Friday, falling $2 to $114/$115 fob, despite strength in Singapore.

Saudi Aramco announced it was raising the price of fuel oil by $3 a tonne to $127 in the Gulf and cutting prices by $1 in the Red Sea, effective from Thursday. Gas oil will rise by $1 to $224 in the Gulf and remain at $225 at Red Sea ports.
